draft.subject: Next step for Blue Partners in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for writing in about inviting a teammate — that ticket is now closed, and as Tariq noted, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time. If it's easier, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Nice work getting your first project set up. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so bringing your teammate in is usually the point where it starts to click.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the invite with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Chidi
